signedOut.title: Sign in to see your family

visible.requestState: Whether your request has been approved

hidden.progress: What they have memorised, or how they are doing

listenTogether.label: Listen together
listenTogether.description: Play it once, both of you listening, and say nothing after.

reciteToMe.label: Let them recite to you
reciteToMe.description: Sit and listen. Do not correct; just listen to the end.

practiseJoin.label: Practise the join
practiseJoin.description: Hear the āyah before it, then let them find the next one.

quietReview.label: Quiet review
quietReview.description: They read it through on their own, unhurried.

tutoring.title: Work you set
tutoring.none: You have not set any work
tutoring.onlyYours: You may hear work you set yourself. Work the teacher set, the teacher hears.

settings.eraseWarning: Erasure removes the record of what {child} did. It cannot be undone.
